meta.ogDescription: VIAV: Network test & measurement leader riding 5G/AI/fiber wave. 4 EPS beats, +150% from Aug lows. Grade B+.

verdict.summary: Viavi Solutions is a network infrastructure play riding the 5G, AI, and fiber optic buildout wave. The company provides test & measurement equipment critical for deploying next-generation networks, plus optical security products (anti-counterfeiting, 3D sensing). After a massive +150% rally from August 2025 lows ($11), VIAV trades at $27.60 — near its analyst consensus target of $27.21. Four consecutive earnings beats signal genuine fundamental improvement, but the stock is now priced for perfection with an EV/EBITDA of 35.9x.
whyBuy: 4 consecutive EPS beats — execution is improving
$699M cash vs $670M debt — net cash positive
Analyst consensus: Strong Buy with $27.21 target
whyAvoid: Negative net income (-3.4% profit margin) despite revenue growth
EV/EBITDA 35.9x — richly valued for a hardware company

risks.riskSummary: VIAV has a clean balance sheet and strong fundamentals, but the +150% rally creates significant mean-reversion risk. The primary threats are valuation compression and execution risk in a shifting macro environment.
